mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tag_event_log ( device_id, department_id, request_id, uid, result_code ) VALUES ( #{deviceId}, #{departmentId}, #{requestId}, #{uid}, 'PROCESSING' ) ON CONFLICT (device_id, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT card.id AS card_id, card.status AS card_status, assignment.department_id AS assignment_department_id FROM public.nfc_card AS card LEFT JOIN public.nfc_card_assignment AS assignment ON assignment.nfc_card_id = card.id AND assignment.unassigned_at IS NULL WHERE card.uid = #{uid}

SELECT day.id, day.policy_version_id, day.status, policy.check_in_start_time FROM public.attendance_day AS day JOIN public.attendance_policy_version AS policy ON policy.id = day.policy_version_id AND policy.department_id = day.department_id WHERE day.department_id = #{departmentId} AND day.attendance_date = #{attendanceDate} FOR UPDATE OF day

SELECT card.id AS card_id, membership.id AS membership_id, membership.member_id FROM public.nfc_card AS card JOIN public.nfc_card_assignment AS assignment ON assignment.nfc_card_id = card.id AND assignment.department_id = #{departmentId} AND assignment.unassigned_at IS NULL JOIN public.department_membership AS membership ON membership.id = assignment.membership_id AND membership.department_id = assignment.department_id AND membership.member_id = assignment.member_id AND membership.ended_at IS NULL WHERE card.uid = #{uid} AND card.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE OF card, assignment, membership

INSERT INTO public.attendance_record ( attendance_day_id, policy_version_id, member_id, attendance_band_id, status, band_sequence_snapshot, band_label_snapshot, checked_in_at, source ) VALUES ( #{attendanceDayId}, #{policyVersionId}, #{memberId}, #{attendanceBandId}, #{status}, #{bandSequence}, #{bandLabel}, #{checkedInAt}, 'NFC' ) RETURNING id

UPDATE public.tag_event_log SET nfc_card_id = #{nfcCardId}, attendance_day_id = #{attendanceDayId}, attendance_record_id = #{attendanceRecordId}, result_code = #{resultCode}, http_status = #{httpStatus}, response_body = CAST(#{responseBody} AS jsonb) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND result_code = 'PROCESSING' RETURNING response_body::text
